source: A fire wyrmic aspiring to win the tournament. He comes paired with an ice wyrmic.
target: 一位立志赢得比赛的炎龙战士。他常和一位冰龙战士一起。

source:
When you throw your alchemist bombs, you infuse them with flames that burn for a few turns.
		In addition all fire damage you do is increased by %d%%.
		You cannot have more than one alchemist infusion sustain active at once.
target:
投掷炼金炸弹时，为其注入会持续灼烧数回合的火焰。
		此外，你造成的所有火焰伤害提高 %d%%。
		同一时间只能激活一种炼金充能持续技能。

source: The target consumed souls to gain new powers. %d spells affected.
target: 目标消耗灵魂以获得新的力量。%d 个法术受到影响。

source: The target has a %d%% chance (stacking to a maximum of %d%%) to fail to cast any spell.  At level 2 magical effects may be disrupted, at level 3 magical sustains may be disrupted, and at level 5 magical constructs and undead may be stunned.
target: 目标施放任何法术时有 %d%% 几率失败（最高叠加至 %d%%）。等级 2 时可能打断魔法效果，等级 3 时可能打断魔法持续技能，等级 5 时可能震慑魔法构装体与亡灵。

source: Thermal energies are focussed in the core of this mindstar.
target: 热能集中在这个灵晶的核心里。

source:
Carved with runes of power, this staff seems to have been made long ago, yet it bears no signs of tarnish.
Light around it seems to dim and you can feel its tremendous power simply by touching it.
The Sorcerers seem to have awakened its power.
#{italic}#"And lo they came to Amakthel himself, and thousands were killed in the assault on his throne, and three of the Godslayers were broken beneath his feet. But Falion with his dying breath pierced the great god on his knee with the icy sword Arkil, and seeing his opportunity Caldizar, leader of the Godslayers, advanced with the Staff of Absorption and struck a terrifying blow against Amakthel. So fell the greatest of the gods by the hands of his own children, and his face was forced into the dust."#{normal}#
target:
杖身铭刻着强大的符文。这根法杖似乎铸造于久远年代，却毫无锈蚀的痕迹。
它周围的光线仿佛也随之暗淡；仅仅触摸它，你就能感受到其中蕴藏的惊人力量。
巫师们似乎已经唤醒了它的力量。
#{italic}#“于是，他们来到阿马克泰尔本人面前。数千人在进攻他的王座时丧生，三名弑神者被碾碎在他脚下。然而，法利恩在临终之际用冰剑阿奇尔刺中了伟大神祇的膝盖。弑神者首领凯尔帝勒抓住机会，手持吸能法杖上前，对阿马克泰尔发动了骇人的一击。众神中最强大的存在就这样倒在自己的儿女手中，脸也被压进尘土。”#{normal}#

source:
Activate some of your inner magic, using it to power your abilities.  For the next %d turns all active talents will be used without resource cost.
		Your resources must still be high enough to initially power the talent and failure rates (etc.) still apply.
target:
激活你的内在潜力，以提高你的能力。
		在接下来 %d 回合中可无消耗使用技能。
		你的能量值仍需要满足使用这些技能的最低能量需求，且技能仍有几率会失败。

source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the ritch tunnels and vanquished their queen.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你调查了里奇通道并击败了它们的虫母。#WHITE#

deep_observation: 漏译物种定义属性 aquatic：原文「an aquatic subspecies of yeeks」，译文仅作「夺心魔的一支亚种」，「水生」完全缺失。补查依据——组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/general/npcs/yaech.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63（blob c61d4e9b0ff6c4b2f7cefeaab04359d5d30c78be）：第 50/65/81/99 行四处 desc 均为该原文；同文件第 23-34 行 BASE_NPC_YAECH 定义 can_breath={water=1}、color=colors.AQUAMARINE、auto_equip_filters MAINHAND subtype=trident，证明水生是机制事实而非修辞，漏译造成设定信息缺失。
source: Yaeches are an aquatic subspecies of yeeks. They share the same psionic powers, but they refuse to take part in the Way.
surface_observation: 原文“an aquatic subspecies”中的“aquatic（水生）”在译文中遗漏。
target: 夺魂魔是夺心魔的一支亚种。他们拥有同样的灵能，但夺魂魔拒绝加入维网。

source: #Target# is pinned by a bone spike.

Worn by a villain long forgotten, this armor was powered by the blood of thousands of innocents. Decrepit and old, the dark lord died in solitude, his dominion crumbled, his subjects gone. Only this cuirass remained, dying to finally taste fresh blood again.
target: 这件胸甲属于一个早已被人遗忘的暴君，成千上万无辜死者的鲜血强化了这件铠甲。黑暗领主最终在衰老与虚弱中孤独的死去，他的统治分崩离析，他的人民四散而去。只有这件胸甲被保留了下来，渴望着再次品尝鲜血的味道。

deep_observation: 机制条件错译：原文「consumes the mark on hit」为命中时才消耗标记，译文「使用将消耗掉标记」把条件放宽成一经使用即消耗；射击未命中时标记实际仍保留，与译文不符。补查依据——组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/talents/techniques/archery.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63（blob 8329ffb39c8d6f119ee91a96de754716b8f757a8）：第 417 行 name=Headshot，第 450 行起的 archery_onhit 中第 459-460 行才执行 target:removeEffect(target.EFF_MARKED)；沿调用链查 game/modules/tome/class/interface/Archery.lua 第 447-458 行，archery_onhit 仅在 hitted=true 分支（第 449 行）调用，未命中走 else 分支的 archery_onmiss（第 457 行），不移除 EFF_MARKED。
source:
Fire a precise shot dealing %d%% weapon damage, with 100 increased accuracy. This shot will bypass other enemies between you and your target.
Only usable against marked targets, and consumes the mark on hit.
surface_observation: 原文“consumes the mark on hit”限定命中时消耗标记，译文“使用将消耗掉标记”改成使用即消耗，丢失命中条件。
target:
瞄准目标头部发射穿透性弹药，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
此次攻击额外获得 100 命中，且能穿透目标以外单位。
只能对被标记的单位使用，使用将消耗掉标记。

source: 15% chance to animate a bleeding foe's blood
Deals %d light damage and heals the summoner for %d
target: 造成 %d 光系伤害，并恢复召唤者 %d 生命值。

source:
Sends a telepathic attack, trying to destroy the brains of any target in the beam, doing %0.2f mind damage.
		The damage will increase with your Mindpower.
target:
向前方发出一道心灵光束，摧毁范围内所有目标的神经系统，造成 %0.2f 精神伤害。
		伤害受精神强度加成。

source: Your Smokescreen is infused with chokedust. Enemies in the smoke take %0.2f nature damage and may be silenced.
target: 你的烟雾弹中加入了窒息粉尘。每回合烟雾中的敌人将受到 %0.2f 自然伤害并有几率被沉默。

source:
Increases your golem's life, mana and stamina regeneration rates by %0.2f.
		At level 1, 3 and 5, the golem also gains a new rune slot.
		Even without this talent, Golems start with three rune slots.
target:
增加傀儡 %0.2f 生命、法力和耐力回复。
		在等级 1、3、5 时，傀儡会增加 1 个新的符文孔。
		即使没有此天赋，傀儡默认也有 3 个符文孔。

source: You veil yourself in shadows and let them control you. While in the veil you become immune to status effects, and gain %d%% all damage reduction. Each turn you blink to a nearby foe within range %d, hitting it for %d%% darkness weapon damage. While this goes on you cannot be stopped unless you are killed, and you cannot control your character.
target: 你融入暗影并被其支配，当你笼罩在阴影里时你对所有状态免疫，并减少 %d%% 所受伤害，每回合你可以闪到 1 个附近的敌人身边 (半径 %d)，对其造成 %d%% 暗影武器伤害。当此技能激活时除非死亡否则无法被打断，且你无法控制你的角色。

source:
You take close notice of the target for the next 5 turns. If they attempt to use a non-instant talent you react with incredible speed, firing a shot dealing 25%% damage that causes the talent to fail and go on cooldown.
This shot is instant, cannot miss, and puts %d other talents on cooldown for %d turns.
target:
你在接下来的 5 回合内密切关注目标。当其使用非瞬间技能时，你立刻做出反应，射出一箭造成 25%% 伤害打断技能并使其进入冷却。
该攻击为瞬间击中，必中，并使其它 %d 个技能进入冷却 %d 回合。

source:
Inch-thick stralite plates lock together with voratun joints. The whole suit looks impenetrable, but has clearly been subjected to terrible treatment - great dents and misshaping warps, and caustic fissures bored across the surface.
Though clearly a powerful piece, it must once have been much greater.
target:
一英寸厚的斯莱特板甲，关节部分由沃瑞钽组成。整套铠甲看起来异常坚固，但是显然它有过非常可怕的经历——巨大的凹痕、扭曲的关节以及腐蚀的表面。
虽然这显然是一件强大的装备，但它曾经一定更为强大。

source: Have dealt over 50000 light or fire damage
target: 曾造成50000点以上的光系或者火系伤害
在聊天中链接这个物品

source: This hat's broad brim protects you from biting colds and sudden storms.
target: 这顶帽子宽阔的帽檐保护您免受呼啸的寒风和突如其来的暴风雨。

source: Hey maybe you would like some of this delicious lookin troll intestines? #LIGHT_GREEN#[Feed him the intestines]#WHITE#
target: 嘿，想不想来点这看起来很美味的巨魔肠子？#LIGHT_GREEN#[把肠子喂给它]#WHITE#
通用 增加力量属性值

deep_observation: 「invoke your spirit」译作「激发你的灵魂」，动宾指向对自身灵魂的内部激发，丢失「把灵体召唤到身旁空格」的外部召唤语义；该提示恰恰是身旁无空位、无法放置实体时才出现，译文与报错原因脱节。补查依据——组件 tome，公开源码 game/modules/tome/data/talents/psionic/mentalism.lua，固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63（blob 874026796fb8e06bc3b22c41d2bf251146a398b1）：第 134 行 name=Projection，第 146 行 util.findFreeGrid(self.x, self.y, 1, true, {[Map.ACTOR]=true}) 寻找相邻空格，第 147-150 行找不到空格才 logPlayer 该提示；第 152-161 行 self:cloneActor 生成 subtype=ghost、name="Projection of %s"、desc「A ghostly figure.」的独立单位，第 188 行 game.zone:addEntity(game.level, m, "actor", x, y) 将其放入该空格。
source: Not enough space to invoke your spirit!
surface_observation: 原文表示空间不足以召唤灵体，译文“激发你的灵魂”将召唤行为误译为激发自身灵魂。
target: 没有空间激发你的灵魂！

source: Arriving at the location given by the coordinates, you see an enormous crack in the ground; peering down, the gleam of exposed metal catches your eye, and you recognize it as a massive door.  It would seem that the Cataclysm's tectonic upheaval has carved a path right to one of its entrances, bypassing the ruined tunnels entirely. You climb down, just outside the door.
target: 到达坐标指定的位置后，你看见地面上裂开一道巨大缝隙；俯身望下去，裸露金属的闪光吸引了你的目光，你认出那是一扇巨大的门。看来，大灾变引发的地壳剧变直接劈出了一条通往其中一个入口的路，完全绕过了已毁的隧道。你攀爬而下，来到大门外。

source: #GREY#%s explodes in a blast of gore!
Master? I am not your mas...
You have learned how to create Nightshade traps!
target: 你学会了如何制作颠茄陷阱！

source:
Toggle for movement mode.
Default: when trying to move onto a creature it will attack if hostile.
Passive: when trying to move onto a creature it will not attack (use ctrl+direction, or right click to attack manually)
target:
切换移动模式。
默认：向敌对目标移动则会直接攻击。
被动：向一个生物移动不会攻击（可以使用Ctrl+ 方向键或者右键点击来攻击）。
